newsitem.title: CANADA: Sidus, ROSS in distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: Sidus, ROSS in distribution deal.

text.p: Sidus Systems Inc said on Wednesday it reached a worldwide distribution agreement with ROSS Technology Inc's SPARC-based products to Sidus's network of resellers and system integrators.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.
Sidus said the product line includeed ROSS hyperSTATION workstation systems, hyperSTATION PC systems, hyperSTATION motherboard upgrade products and hyperSPARC microprocessor upgrade products.

"This agreement provides Sidus with the ability to expand significantly its offerings in the SPARC marketplace for our distribution and private label manufacturing businesses," said Sidus president and chief executive Henry Kalisky.
